description:
Ordinary office worker Jang Heekyung runs into Jiho, his first love he thought he had long forgotten, on his way home from work one evening. Drawn in as if under a spell, Heekyung follows the traces of that familiar warmth, but the Jiho he meets again is nothing like the one he once knew...

**Original Webtoon:**  
[MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_cambion_wz), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/55035867), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6119622)
